## The through-line: an 8-step Bayesian workflow

Everything in this course builds toward one skill — running a complete Bayesian analysis
end to end. The **take-home exam is exactly that**, on a dataset you'll meet at the end. You
see the whole workflow in week 1 and deepen it each week.

{{< include slides/_workflow-8step.qmd >}}

## Homework & feedback policy

> **A sample solution is published for every homework.** Individual feedback is **not** provided
> by default — with one exception.
>
> **Opt-in AI feedback.** If you add an open-source `license.md` to your submission repo, you opt
> in to automated, individualized feedback: an AI reads your submission alongside the sample
> solution and writes a `FEEDBACK.qmd` / `FEEDBACK.pdf` back into your repo. No `license.md`, no
> processing. This is entirely optional.

## Passing requirements

- Attendance and homework completion thresholds are published on the [Schedule](schedule.qmd).
- Homework completion is tracked automatically from your submission repos — submit on the org.

## Assessment

- **Take-home exam** — a full 8-step Bayesian analysis (the terminal deliverable).
- Homeworks are formative practice for the exam.
